cues.en: Instructor: In our thought experiment in the previous video, you and I were going out and measuring samples of data and then repeating those samples,
cues.zh: 講師：上一部思想實驗中，你我出去量樣本，再重複抽樣，

cues.en: repeating that experiment 500 times.
cues.zh: 實驗重複 500 次。

cues.en: Now the thing is, when you actually sit down to do science, when you're doing research, when you're analyzing already collected data, you don't really have the ability
cues.zh: 真正做科學、研究、分析既有資料時，通常不太能

cues.en: to go out and repeat your experiment 500 times, typically.
cues.zh: 出去重複 500 次。

cues.en: Occasionally you do, but usually you don't.
cues.zh: 偶爾可以，但通常不行。

cues.en: Usually you just get one sample of data, so you just measure 80 individuals and that's it.
cues.zh: 通常只有一組樣本，例如測 80 個人，就結束。

cues.en: You don't repeat that experiment 500 times.
cues.zh: 不會重複 500 次。

cues.en: So we need a way to compute confidence intervals based on one sample dataset.
cues.zh: 需要根據單一資料樣本計算信賴區間。

cues.en: And so that's leads us to the first of two methods for computing confidence intervals and this is via a formula.
cues.zh: 這帶到兩種方法中的第一種，透過公式。

cues.en: So let's just dive right in.
cues.zh: 直接開始。

cues.en: Here's the formula right here.
cues.zh: 公式在這裡。

cues.en: So our confidence interval is the mean, so this would be a confidence interval around the mean, plus or minus, so we have the upper bound and the lower bound.
cues.zh: 信賴區間是平均值，這是平均值周圍的區間，加減，也就是上下界。

cues.en: This particular t thing, which is called t star, I'll talk about that in a moment, times s over the square root of n.
cues.zh: 這個稱為 t 星號的量，稍後說明，乘以 s/√n。

cues.en: So what are all these crazy letters going on here?
cues.zh: 這些字母是什麼？

cues.en: Well, x is the, or this should be x bar, my apologies, so x bar is the sample mean.
cues.zh: x，這應該是 x 上橫線，抱歉，表示樣本平均。

cues.en: T is a t-value, but this is not the t-value associated with a t statistic on the data.
cues.zh: t 是 t 值，但不是對資料做 t 檢定得到的值。

cues.en: That's why it's t star.
cues.zh: 所以叫 t 星號。

cues.en: This is not what you are probably initially thinking is a t-value.
cues.zh: 不是你一開始可能想到的那種 t 值。

cues.en: I'm gonna talk about this in a moment.
cues.zh: 稍後解釋。

cues.en: So s is the sample standard deviation, your empirical sample standard deviation, and n is the sample size.
cues.zh: s 是實際樣本標準差，n 是樣本大小。

cues.en: Now, in the previous video I said that the sample size and standard deviation are important for defining the ranges of the confidence intervals
cues.zh: 上一部說樣本數和標準差，對定義區間範圍，

cues.en: or the width of the confidence interval.
cues.zh: 或寬度很重要。

cues.en: And in the previous video, I left that up to your intuition to allow that to make sense.
cues.zh: 當時留給直覺理解。

cues.en: And here you see the formula, and I wanna focus on this a little bit more.
cues.zh: 這裡看公式，再多談一點。

cues.en: So in fact, what I'm gonna do is just momentarily delete this t-value here, and we can just focus on this.
cues.zh: 先暫時刪掉這個 t，專注這部分。

cues.en: This is also a general principle in mathematics.
cues.zh: 這也是數學的一般原則。

cues.en: If you're trying to understand an equation, if you're looking at an equation that looks really big and long and confusing, you're not sure what it means, one thing you can try to do
cues.zh: 想理解一個又大、又長、令人困惑的方程式，不確定意義時，

cues.en: is just cover up parts of the equation, ignore them, just call them some constant, just forget about them, and then focus on simpler parts of the equation
cues.zh: 可以遮住某些部分、忽略，稱作常數，先忘掉，再專注較簡單、

cues.en: that you can think about.
cues.zh: 能思考的部分。

cues.en: So forgetting about this t thing for a moment, that's just some constant, it's just a variable, now we can see that the confidence interval around the mean
cues.zh: 暫時忘掉 t，把它當常數、變數，就看到平均周圍信賴區間，

cues.en: is related to the ratio of s to square root of n.
cues.zh: 和 s 對 √n 的比值有關。

cues.en: So now you see mathematically what you thought intuitively in the previous video, which is that as s gets smaller, so the variability in the data gets smaller,
cues.zh: 從數學看到上一部的直覺，s 越小、資料變異越小，

cues.en: then the confidence intervals are also getting smaller.
cues.zh: 區間也越小。

cues.en: Conversely, as n gets larger, then the confidence intervals are also getting smaller.
cues.zh: 反過來，n 越大，區間也越小。

cues.en: So obviously the ideal way to go here is to have a large n and a small variability.
cues.zh: 所以理想上，是大 n、小變異。

cues.en: That's going to give you a small confidence interval.
cues.zh: 會給小信賴區間。

cues.en: Okay, so now I wanna talk about this t term here.
cues.zh: 現在談 t 這一項。

cues.en: So I'm calling this t star, t asterisk, because this is not the same kind of t-value that you have been learning about in the previous section,
cues.zh: 稱 t 星號、t asterisk，是因為和上一章學的 t 值

cues.en: for example.
cues.zh: 不同。

cues.en: This does come from a t distribution, which is why it's called t, but it's not actually a t test.
cues.zh: 確實來自 t 分布，所以叫 t，但不是真正的 t 檢定。

cues.en: This is not a t statistic.
cues.zh: 不是 t 統計量。

cues.en: So this is the t value associated with one tail of the confidence interval.
cues.zh: 是信賴區間一側尾部所對應的 t 值。

cues.en: So that looks like this.
cues.zh: 像這樣。

cues.en: So we can call the function, t inverse, and t inverse allows us to specify a probability value, and the output of this t inverse function
cues.zh: 呼叫 t inverse，也就是 t 反函式，指定機率值，輸出

cues.en: is going to be the t-value associated with that probability at those degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: 為該機率、該自由度對應的 t 值。

cues.en: So n here corresponds to the sample size.
cues.zh: n 對應樣本大小。

cues.en: So we have n minus one degrees of freedom, because we are looking at the mean, we're getting a confidence interval around the mean.
cues.zh: 因為看平均、計算平均的信賴區間，有 n−1 個自由度。

cues.en: And here I say one minus .05.
cues.zh: 這裡寫 1 減 0.05。

cues.en: So this means that we're looking at a 95% confidence interval here, and then I divide by two, because we want one tail.
cues.zh: 表示看 95% 信賴區間，再除以 2，因為要一側尾部。

cues.en: And the reason why we want one tail in the t inverse function is because we need the confidence interval to be two tailed, right?
cues.zh: t 反函式要一尾，是因為需要雙尾信賴區間，對吧？

cues.en: So we have the confidence interval above and the confidence interval below.
cues.zh: 平均值上方、下方都有信賴區間。

cues.en: So this is a two tailed confidence interval, right?
cues.zh: 是雙尾。

cues.en: We have an upper bound and a lower bound, so therefore, we have to divide our confidence percentage by two.
cues.zh: 有上界、下界，所以信心百分比必須除以 2。

cues.en: Okay, so for example, the confidence, 95% confidence interval for n equals 20 gives a t-value of 2.093.
cues.zh: 例如，n=20 的 95% 信賴區間，t 值為 2.093。

cues.en: Now, we still, you know, just based on this information, we still can't actually compute a confidence interval, because we know this number and now we know this number.
cues.zh: 只根據這些資訊，還不能算出區間，因為知道這個、現在又知道那個，

cues.en: We still don't know this number and this number.
cues.zh: 仍不知道這兩個。

cues.en: So just knowing the n and the confidence interval is not sufficient for computing a confidence interval.
cues.zh: 所以只知道 n 和信賴水準，不足以計算區間。

cues.en: Okay, pictorially, that looks something like this.
cues.zh: 圖像上像這樣。

cues.en: So this blue line here would correspond to a t distribution.
cues.zh: 藍線對應 t 分布。

cues.en: This is an analytic t score distribution.
cues.zh: 解析的 t 分數分布。

cues.en: And for a 95% confidence interval, we wanna find this t value and this t value.
cues.zh: 95% 區間要找這個 t 值，以及這個 t 值。

cues.en: So that is, it's not 5%, it's 2% on each side giving us a total of 5%, and that's this t star value here.
cues.zh: 不是 5%，而是每側 2%，總共 5%，這就是 t 星號。

cues.en: So this formula, applying this formula, has some underlying assumptions.
cues.zh: 套用公式有基本假設。

cues.en: I would like you to pause the video now and think about what the assumptions of this formula are and whether you believe that those assumptions are valid
cues.zh: 請暫停影片，想想假設是什麼，是否相信這些假設有效，

cues.en: and whether we can trust that those assumptions should be valid in most data sets.
cues.zh: 以及大部分資料集能否信任它們成立。

cues.en: Okay, did you have a go at that?
cues.zh: 有想想嗎？

cues.en: So here's what I wrote.
cues.zh: 這是我寫的。

cues.en: The key assumption here is that s, this variable here, is an appropriate measure of dispersion or variability in the dataset.
cues.zh: 關鍵假設是，s 這個變數，是適當的資料離散程度、變異量值。

cues.en: So in this video, you learned how to compute confidence intervals by applying a formula.
cues.zh: 這部影片學到透過公式計算信賴區間。

cues.en: In the next video, you'll get some experience working through this in code, and then I will talk about computing confidence intervals empirically via bootstrapping.
cues.zh: 下一部會用程式操作，之後再談透過拔靴法計算經驗信賴區間。
